Map: thermal: ironbow heat map. xray: X-ray look. night: night vision green. custom: gradient of Colora, Colorb and Colorc.
Driver: luma: use brightness of in1. in2: use in2 (falls back to in1 if unconnected).
Gain: Multiplier on the driver value before mapping. Higher = brighter end of the map.
Bias: Offset added to the driver value before mapping.
Edges: Strength of the Sobel edge overlay on the driver. 0 = off.
Noise: Amount of sensor noise: temporal grain plus fixed column pattern. 0 = clean.
Isotherms: Strength of contour lines drawn at 8 levels. 0 = off.
Mixoriginal: Blend the original image back over the false colours (0-1).
Modamount: Scales the modulation CHOP (in3). band1 adds to Gain. 0 = ignore.
Crosshair: Show the reticle, ticks, corner brackets and level meter reading the value at Target.
Legend: Show a gradient scale bar on the right.
Target: Position (0-1) the crosshair and its level meter read.
Hudcolor: Colour of the crosshair and HUD elements.
Colora: Custom map: colour of low values.
Colorb: Custom map: colour of mid values.
Colorc: Custom map: colour of high values.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
